_about: Closed-session notice items with hand-written expected values. Real items were pulled Oct 23, 2026 from all five reachable jurisdictions (CivicClerk, BoardBook, AgendaCenter, Municode) and checked verbatim against the source after whitespace normalization and HTML unescaping; cases marked synthetic are invented edge cases. 'other_citations' lists every statute cited other than 19.85 (municipal code numbers excluded). 'purpose_contains' is a substring purpose_text() must return; null means purpose_text() must return "" (statute only) or None (no citation).
